title: Pandemic & disease outbreak
tldr: Check current local health guidance for the specific disease. Reduce exposure, stay home when sick when feasible and seek care for severe symptoms. Recommended tests, vaccines, masks and isolation steps depend on the pathogen and your health risks.
steps: Use the local health department and CDC disease-specific updates.
Improve cleaner indoor air and use recommended precautions for the way the disease spreads.
Ask your clinician about risk, treatment access and continuity of essential medicines.
Seek emergency help for severe breathing difficulty, new confusion or other life-threatening symptoms.
next: Arrange sick-leave, caregiver and household supply plans. Verify information before sharing it.
watch: Do not transfer isolation durations or treatment advice from one disease to another.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Create a workable sick-person area, improve ventilation where safe and separate shared food, washing and care tasks. Keep medicines and a written symptom record. Obtain disease-specific guidance when possible; do not use unproven treatments or copy isolation rules from another outbreak.
household: Make the care plan workable with the people, room and supplies you have. Separate clean and dirty tasks, check high-risk household members and preserve access to essential medicines.
